summary: Exited at +55.75pts (t=3m) after a clean run-up with 0% giveback. The trigger was a convergence of overextension signals: volatility expanding sharply (+8.3 delta), the fastest-TF (5s) lambda_hat flipping strongly negative (t=-4.23, a mean-reversion flag) even while 15s lambda stayed positive, and PROPP-against firing twice in the prior 3 minutes while price kept making new highs -- a classic blow-off signature. Next time I'd watch whether the 5s/15s lambda disagreement resolves before the peak (it may be an earlier, cheaper exit cue) and whether two consecutive against-fires during a new high is a reliable enough pattern on its own to trigger without waiting for the vol spike confirmation.
